The E5L5 mask is the outer product of E5 down the columns and L5 along the rows:

\[
E5^{\mathsf T} L5 = \begin{bmatrix}
  -1 & -4 & -6 & -4 & -1 \\
  -2 & -8 & -12 & -8 & -2 \\
  0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\
  2 & 8 & 12 & 8 & 2 \\
  1 & 4 & 6 & 4 & 1
\end{bmatrix}
\]

Its rows weight a smoothed difference from top to bottom, so it responds to horizontal edges and texture. Its weights add up to 0, so flat areas give 0. The filter takes the absolute response and averages it over the energy window.
